overview_description.description: Alif Semiconductor develops 32-bit microcontrollers and fusion processors for intelligent embedded and Internet of Things devices. Its product families include Ensemble, which combines microcontroller and microprocessor cores with hardware acceleration for artificial intelligence and machine learning, and Balletto, which integrates edge AI processing with Bluetooth Low Energy and other wireless connectivity. The devices incorporate processing, memory, security, power management, sensing, imaging, audio, and communication interfaces on a single chip. Alif Semiconductor also provides development resources, software tools, evaluation kits, technical documentation, and design-partner support for developers building connected endpoint products. Its processors address applications including wearables, fitness trackers, smart retail, mobile point-of-sale systems, healthcare devices, security systems, and other battery-operated IoT products.
